meta.population: 2020 Census block groups (CenPop2020 centers of population, U.S. Census Bureau); 3,190,369 people
meta.elections: 2016: precinct (VEST via ALARM 2010 blocks); carried to 2020 block groups; 2020: precinct (VEST via ALARM 2010 blocks); carried to 2020 block groups; 2024: county (DRA/RDH VTD totals) on 2020 precinct pattern; carried to 2020 block groups
meta.method: 2016/2020: VEST precinct results disaggregated to 2010 blocks by voting-age population (ALARM Project) and summed to 2010 block groups. 2024: county totals of RDH precinct results (via Dave's Redistricting) spread within each county in proportion to the block group's 2020 vote for the same party. All three are then carried to 2020 block groups: each takes the votes-per-person rate of its nearest 2010 block groups in the same county times its 2020 population, rescaled to the county totals. Precinct-to-block disaggregation and the 2010-to-2020 carry make block-group values approximate; statewide and county totals are preserved. Data CC BY-SA 4.0 (ALARM, DRA), VEST CC BY 4.0.
